_comment: Operationally-variable values behind Instant mode's repotaxmannapi-parity boosting/exclusion logic - the kind of thing the real .NET source keeps in Web.config app-settings or a live SQL-backed dataset (GstTariffBL), not compile-time code. Structural taxonomy ids ported from repotaxmannapi/TaxmannAPI/BL/Constants.cs (compile-time constants there, e.g. wcc/wc1's ComparativeGroupId/CirNot/CentralGST) are NOT here - those don't drift the way years/current-editions/tuned weights do, so they stay as code constants in common/es_client.py and common/repotaxmannapi_scoring.py, matching how the real source itself treats them. See docs/pending-data-followups.md for what's confirmed-real vs still-guessed, and CLAUDE.md hard rule 5 (boost_source default) for the one decision this file does NOT cover.

latest_edition_years._comment: groups.group.subgroup.id -> the one year.name.keyword a global search narrows that subgroup to (SearchTextElastic.cs::GetGlobalSearchQuery's minusQuery). Confirmed against repotaxmannapi/TaxmannAPI/Web.config 2026-09-03 (LattestActYearID/LattestItAct2025ActPageYearID/LattestStlFinanceActYearID all matched).

gst_tariff._comment: GST Tariff's latest-edition hard exclusion - 3 subgroups under the one top-level 'Tariff' group (groups.group.id 111050000000017179), matching SearchTextElastic.cs's 3 EditionGoodsLatestFilter/EditionServicesLatestFilter/EditionCGSTplusSGSTLatestFilter re-admission clauses (the real source excludes the WHOLE group via one GstTarrifMinusFilter and re-admits per-subgroup; this repo instead runs 3 independent subgroup-scoped exclusions with the same net effect - see _gst_tariff_latest_edition_filter's own docstring). CGST+SGST (2026-09-03 addition) was found missing entirely in an earlier pass - a real gap, not a zero-doc future-proofing case: 413 live docs had NO latest-edition filtering applied at all before this was added. Real source resolves all 3 via a live SQL-backed GstTariffBL dataset lookup, not an app-setting - every id below was derived directly from this repo's own live ES index (2026-09-03). WILL drift as new tariff editions are published - re-derive via a groups.group.subgroup.subsubgroup terms aggregation scoped to each subgroup id (highest 'Edition N' wins) whenever GST tariff results look stale. See docs/pending-data-followups.md.

forms._comment: Forms' latest-edition hard exclusion. formtype_id is repotaxmannapi/TaxmannAPI/BL/Constants.cs's frmtyp002 (compile-time, kept here anyway since it's paired 1:1 with latest_year below). latest_year confirmed real 2026-09-03 from Web.config's LattestFormYear - 0 live Forms docs exist in this index to test either value against yet.

account_standard._comment: Account Standard's year-2015-only exclusion (SearchTextElastic.cs's minusASQuery). 0 live docs - implemented for when this content type is indexed.

oecd_model_commentaries._comment: OECD Model Commentaries admitted only for this year (SearchTextElastic.cs's OecdModelLatestCommentaryFilter). 0 live docs.

edition_boosts_by_instrument_kind._comment: Should-clause boosts for a bare section/rule number defaulting to Income-tax Act/Rules (query_tokenizer.default_instrument_kind) - [subgroup_id, boost] pairs, current edition weighted higher (3:2 ratio in the real source, GlobalSearchResearch.cs:623-624).

static_group_membership_boosts._comment: Unconditional per-document group-membership should-boosts ported from SearchTextElastic.cs::GetGlobalSearchQuery's positive OR-list (line 785). Real weights (16000-35000) scaled by the same ~0.25 factor edition_boosts_by_instrument_kind applies to its own real weights (80000 -> 15000/20000). [subgroup_id, boost] pairs.

finance_act_general._comment: Finance Act (general) current-edition should-boost (FinanceActBoostquery, real weight 30000 scaled to 7500). NOT a hard exclusion - see docs/pending-data-followups.md / es_client.py's 2026-09-03 correction note for why an earlier version wrongly excluded every non-current-year edition.

group_signal_should_boosts._comment: groups.group.name.keyword should-clause boosts fired by detect_group_signals/keyword_shape_group_filter - scaled under _PHRASE_BOOSTS' 100000/50000/40000 tier (see es_client.py's 2026-09-01 magnitude-correction comment for why these are NOT centax-node's original 2,000,000/10,000,000 values).

static_taxonomy_boosts._comment: Unconditional function_score tie-breaker weights ([field, value, weight] triples) - small-scale, ported from centax-node's legacy query_legacy.json sample, live-verified against this repo's own index before being trusted (see es_client.py's own comment on this constant).

latest_finance_act_year_for_multiply_for._comment: repotaxmannapi_scoring.build_function_score_functions's latest_finance_act_year parameter (GlobalSearchResearch.cs:538's LattestFinanceActYearID app-setting) - the multiply-mode formula's own penalty-function equivalent of finance_act_general.current_year above. Kept as a separate key since the real source reads it as an independent app-setting call, not shared code, even though the value happens to match today.
